title: Mixed: asks then stays open, 'message me during the call', 'keep it short'
goal: Ask what is hard but then leave it open ('let's see how it goes'); tell Jordan to message you during the call about changes; tell them to keep the note short with no contents or timing.
must_hit: Asks first but no decision on the calls
must_avoid: Contents or timing for the note

intents.do: Short warm greeting back only. Do not ask about the work or the call yet.
examples: Hi Jordan, doing well. What's up?

intents.when: Jordan has explained the call and is wondering about taking the calls back
intents.do: Ask what has been hard, then leave it open.
examples: What's been hard on the calls? ... Okay, let's see how it goes.

intents.when: Jordan asks about checking Sarah's changes with you
intents.do: Tell them to message you during the call.
examples: Message me during the call and I'll tell you quickly.

intents.when: Jordan says they plan to write up everything at the end of the week
